Name: Hay Bales as Silos
Author: ChroniclerCherry
TagLine: Changes Hay Bales so they store hay like silos when placed around the farm.
Description:
Changes Hay Bales so they store hay like silos when placed around the farm.

**Install**

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io).

2.  Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

3.  Run the game using SMAPI.
**How to use**
You can buy Hay Bales from Marnie's shop for 5,000 gold. Place them in any location (usually the farm) to increase its hay capacity by 240 per bale. You can interact with a hay bale to see your current capacity or store hay, just like a regular silo.

You can open the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] file (which is generated when you run the game with the mod) in a text editor to change these setting:

*   [font=Courier New]RequiresConstructedSilo[/font]: whether you need at least one silo on the farm for hay bales to work. Default true.

*   [font=Courier New]HayPerBale[/font]: how much hay each silo stores. Default 240.

*   [font=Courier New]HayBalePrice[/font]: the gold price for each hay bale in Marnie's shop. Default 5000.

**Common questions**

> **Is the mod still compatible?**
> The mod is compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.

> **Does the mod conflict with any others?**
> There are no known mod conflicts. Feel free to report compatibility issues in the mod comments.

> **Can I safely add/remove the mod anytime?**
> Yep. When you remove the mod, hay bales will simply revert to Ornamental Hay Bales and no longer increase your hay capacity. You can reinstall the mod later and they'll start working again.
